name: Pretpot Massive Addons Kit for Elementor
author: pretpot

sections.description:
Pretpot Massive Addons Kit for Elementor is a powerful WordPress plugin that extends Elementor with 45+ free widgets and features to enhance your website building experience and add new animations.

Free Widgets Include:

  • Simple Cookies – GDPR/CCPA compliant cookie consent banner
  • Header & Footer Builder – Create global headers and footers
  • Blurred Glass Background – Add frosted glass blur effect
  • Text Distortion – Eye-catching scroll and hover text effects
  • Small Button – Compact action button for small screens
  • Search Form – Minimal inline search bar widget
  • Stripe Button – Accept payments via Stripe checkout
  • PayPal Button – Accept payments via PayPal checkout
  • Contact Form 7 Styling – Advanced styling controls for CF7 forms
  • WPForms Styling – Advanced styling controls for WPForms
  • Fluent Forms Styling – Advanced styling controls for Fluent Forms
  • Ninja Forms Styling – Advanced styling controls for Ninja Forms
  • Progress Bar Style 1 – Animated horizontal progress bar widget
  • Simple Slider – Clean image slider with pagination
  • Double Button – Two side-by-side styled buttons
  • Pricing Tables – Beautiful responsive pricing table layouts
  • Pricing Plan – Responsive pricing cards with animations
  • Simple Scroll Up Button – Lightweight scroll to top button
  • Single WooCommerce Product – Display individual products with styling
  • WooCommerce Product Grid – Display products in responsive grid
  • Blog Posts Grid – Display blog posts in customizable grid
  • Table of Contents – Auto-generated TOC with smooth scroll
  • Animated Donut Chart – Animated circular charts with tooltips
  • Currency Converter – Modern converter with flags and rates
  • Basic Music Player – Elegant MP3 player with embed support
  • HD Logo – High-definition logo with retina support
  • Breadcrumb Schema – Auto-generate breadcrumb structured data
  • Organization Schema – Add structured data for organizations
  • Add to Cart Button – Customizable WooCommerce add to cart
  • Vertical Progress Bars – Animated vertical progress indicators
  • Advanced Nav Menu – Feature-rich menu with mega-menu support
  • Simple Image Card – Clean image card with glass blur
  • Recommendation Stack – Stacked recommendation cards with blur
  • Icon Card – Clean card with icons and content
  • Age Restriction Popup – Age verification with cookie support
  • Countdown Timer – Minimalistic circular or card layouts
  • Parallax Image – Smooth parallax scrolling image widget
  • 3D Box Carousel – Interactive 4-face 3D carousel
  • Multicolored Line – Customizable multicolored animated lines
  • Animated Like Button Counter – Interactive like button with particle effects
  • Back Button – Smart navigation to previous page
  • Enhanced Gradient – Multi-stop gradients with animation
  • Smart Tab Anchor Nav – Sticky anchor navigation with scrollspy
  • Horizontal Interactive Cards – Interactive horizontal accordion cards
  • Simple Image Grid – Clean responsive image grid layout
  • Simple Logo Grid – Clean logo grid with hover effects

Additional Features:

  • Header & Footer Builder – Create custom headers and footers with Elementor
  • Skew Control – Add skew transformations to sections, columns, and containers
  • Widget Toggle System – Enable/disable individual widgets to optimize performance

PRO Features Available:

Upgrade to PRO for access to premium widgets including Booking forms, Liquid Glass effects, Marquee, Scroll Video, Lottie animations, Fancy Headings, and more.

External Services

External Services

Stripe

This plugin integrates with Stripe to process payments through the “Pretpot Stripe Button” widget.

What the service is and what it is used for:
Stripe is a payment processing service that allows you to accept credit card payments and other payment methods on your website.

What data is sent and when:
When a customer clicks the payment button, product information (name, description, amount, currency) and your Stripe publishable key are sent to Stripe’s servers via their JavaScript SDK to initiate the checkout process.

Links to service’s terms of service and privacy policy:
– Terms of Service: https://stripe.com/gb/legal/ssa
– Privacy Policy: https://stripe.com/gb/privacy

PayPal

This plugin integrates with PayPal to process payments through the “Pretpot PayPal Button” widget.

What the service is and what it is used for:
PayPal is a payment processing service that allows you to accept payments via PayPal accounts, credit cards, and other payment methods.

What data is sent and when:
When a customer clicks the PayPal button, the following data is sent to PayPal’s servers via form submission: your PayPal email address, product name, SKU (if provided), price, currency code, transaction type (checkout/donation/subscription), and return URL (if configured).

Links to service’s terms of service and privacy policy:
– Terms of Service: https://www.paypal.com/us/legalhub/paypal/useragreement-full
– Privacy Policy: https://www.paypal.com/us/legalhub/paypal/privacy-full
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/pretpot-elementor-kit/, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to ‘Pretpot Massive Addons’ in the WordPress admin sidebar menu to configure settings.
  4. Enable the widgets you want to use.
  5. Start using the widgets in Elementor page builder.
sections.faq:
Is Elementor required?

Yes, this plugin requires Elementor Page Builder to be installed and activated.

Is WooCommerce required?

WooCommerce is only required if you want to use the WooCommerce-specific widgets (Single Product, Product Grid, Add to Cart Button). Other widgets work without WooCommerce.

Can I disable widgets I’m not using?

Yes! Go to Pretpot Massive Addons > Widgets and toggle off any widgets you don’t need. This helps keep your site optimized.

Does this plugin work with Elementor Pro?

Yes, this plugin works alongside both the free version of Elementor and Elementor Pro.

How do I create custom headers and footers?

  1. Go to Pretpot Massive Addons > Header & Footer
  2. Enable the Header & Footer feature
  3. Create templates and assign them as global header/footer
  4. Or assign different headers/footers to specific pages

Is the plugin GDPR compliant?

The Simple Cookies widget helps you display cookie consent banners to comply with GDPR and other privacy regulations.
